plugin.name: PcpEqualiser
plugin.title: Player Equaliser
plugin.desc: Live 10-band equaliser for piCorePlayer players: changes play while you drag the sliders.
plugin.changes: The graph now shows the equaliser's actual effect, computed from its filters, including how wide each band reaches and how neighbouring bands overlap; slider settings are shown as dots.
plugin.creator: NikolajChristensen
